configurations.name: web-preview
configurations.//: The production build (npm run build first): what Render serves. Used by npm run audit:home.

configurations.name: look-frozen
configurations.//: A FROZEN production build for the design-language pixel gate (docs/design-language/PLAN.md Phase 0/1): copy a build into ../.mk-look-builds/serve, then run the audit with E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4174. Source edits never reach it mid-run.

configurations.name: look-candidate
configurations.//: The candidate build beside look-frozen, for side-by-side computed-style checks.

configurations.name: web-crosssite
configurations.//: SPA on localhost, API on 127.0.0.1: two different SITES, so the API's cookies are third-party, exactly as on Render. Reproduces what iPhones (WebKit ITP) see.

configurations.name: api
configurations.//: Plain node, not nodemon: a watcher restarting mid-run is indistinguishable from the API being down.

configurations.name: api-metrics
configurations.//: The api entry with METRICS_TOKEN=dev, so GET /metrics answers locally (curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer dev'). Leaves .env untouched.
